title: Input head moves left during seeking
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine on Boolean input $x$, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$. If an amplified-machine configuration $C$ is in the seek phase for run index $j\in\{0,\ldots,r\}$ and counter $c\in\{0,\ldots,r+1\}$, and its input-head position is nonzero and at most $|x|$, then one step under either choice bit changes only the input-head position, decreasing it by one.
